top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise as Iran Peace Optimism Fades
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices reversed their fall from earlier this week as traders grew less optimistic about a peace deal between the United States and Iran amid continuing tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, with a record number of such attacks in October. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.43 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $86.62 per barrel, both up from the start of the week but still sharply down from the end of October, when Brent crude was over $110 per barrel, and WTI was over $100. As many as 37 vessels were attacked…
